newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's Bucaram sued by ex-rival.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Bucaram sued by ex-rival.

text.p: Jaime Nebot, a former Ecuadorean presidential candidate, said Thursday he was suing President Abdala Bucaram, who accused him of theft, for slander.
"I have come to the courts to sue the lawyer Abdala Bucaram Ortiz. To sue the man and the leader," the former candidate of the Social Christian Party told journalists.
Bucaram earlier accused Nebot of stealing public funds earmarked for construction of a road in Guayaquil, south of Quito.
"He (Bucaram) has become the main aggressor. It is unacceptable to allow him to bully everyone who does not share his views," Nebot said.
He urged the Supreme Court, where he filed the case, to show that in Ecuador "nobody is above the law."
